The decision is the Principal's, with that in front of them.

fields.description: For the Principal and those they permit only. Absent — not hidden — for everybody else (BR-4).

fields.name: not_taken_up
fields.description: Open and held by nobody, with days open. No time limit exists (OQ-4).

fields.name: awaiting_confirmation
fields.description: Outcome recorded and the raiser has not answered. These never close by themselves (E10, OQ-5).

fields.name: confidential_naming_principal
fields.description: For the Principal: confidential complaints about themselves, which have nowhere else to go (E11, OQ-1).

errors.meaning: A desk staff member sought a confidential complaint.

planningRules.rule: Never mention a confidential complaint to anybody but the Principal and those they permit — not a count, not its existence (BR-4, E1).
For the Principal, name any confidential complaint that is about them. It has nowhere else to go and the Principal is the one holding it (E11, OQ-1).
Name what nobody has taken up and what is waiting on a raiser. Neither has any limit and the second never closes on its own (E10, OQ-4, OQ-5).
branch_id comes from $session.

reversal.statement: A read changes nothing, so there is nothing to reverse.

request.text: kaunsi confidential shikayatein mere paas hain?
request.gloss: which confidential complaints are with me?

steps.note: The Principal's own (PR-2).

resolvedPlans.outcome: List them with days open and who else has been permitted to read each. Name separately any that are about the Principal — those have nowhere else to go, and the Principal is the one deciding them.

request.text: staff ki kitni shikayatein khuli hain?
request.gloss: how many staff complaints are open?

steps.note: The ordinary queue only (PR-1).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Give the ordinary queue: open, not taken up (with days), and waiting on a raiser. Nothing about confidential complaints appears — not even whether any exist.
